title: Official Review Advisory Provider (AI Code Reviewer, non-blocking)
description: 補上 deterministic validate 之外的語意式 code review advisory layer，但只作建議，不直接決定 pass/fail。
acceptance: review scope 可來自 changed file list、git diff、upgrade proposal、registry diff 或指定 atom/map 範圍
provider 可以是 stub、agent-bridge、external-cli，core 不直接依賴 vendor SDK
report / evidence 必須能映射到 .atm/reports/* 與 EvidenceStore contract
deterministic validate chain 仍維持單獨可跑，不依賴 advisory provider 可用性
host 端可以用 agent skill / subagent / editor tool 去接入，但那只是 adapter 實作，不是 framework semantic requirement

title: Capability Sandbox 與審計日誌
description: 規劃 Capability Sandbox、權限控管、審計日誌、prompt injection guardrail 與 observability 的 optional plugin 邊界。
acceptance: Deno sandbox/OpenTelemetry/Prometheus 不成為 core 必備依賴
Capability 宣告與審計格式可由 plugin 實作
安全插件缺席時 core 仍能 standalone 運作
threat model / provenance / secrets scan policy 已定義
cost budget policy 與 budget report schema 已對齊
HarnessCard-lite report profile 列出 base model/profile、control artifacts、runtime policy、action substrate、execution topology、feedback stack、observability/evaluation 與 known risks
CAR runtime/audit 對照能標示 Control / Agency / Runtime 來源，不新增 core 必填 schema
